(653)'um̐ḥklong chen snying gi thig le lasaḥbaka' srung ma mgon lcam dral bzhugasaḥ(654)dpal chen khrag 'thung sku la 'dudaḥbla rdzogs thugs gsum yongs rdzogs

tei:div.tei:p: (653)'um̐ḥ klong chen snying gi thig le lasaḥ bka' srung ma mgon lcam dral bzhugasaḥ (654)

dpal chen khrag 'thung sku la 'dudaḥ bla rdzogs thugs gsum yongs rdzogs kyiḥ thun mong ma yin bka' bsrung cheḥ lcam dral gsum gyi phrin las bstanaḥ brag dmar mtsho gling dur khrod dang ཿ bsgrub gnas byin chen la sogs paraḥ rang rang mthun rdzas mchod gtor bshamaḥ lta ba gyabs kyi ngar ldan pasaḥ rang nyid dpal chen por gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phrosaḥ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ du gyur pas mchod rdzas dang gtor ma la (655)phogaḥ raṃ las mes ma dag pa thams cad bsregaḥ khaṃ las chu byung bas sbyangasaḥ yaṃ las rlung byung bas gtor te stong pa'i ngang lasaḥ kaṃ las mi mgo'i sgyed su gsum gyi steng duḥ thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba stong gsum tsam gyi nang du gtor ma so sor oṃ āḥhūm̐ las sha lnga dang bdud (656)rtsi lnga'i rang bzhin ri rab dang rgya mtsho mnyam pas khengasaḥ yaṃ las rlung g.yosaḥ raṃ las me 'bar bas thod pa'i bdud rtsi kholaḥ zla ba'i kha chod rdo rje rtse lnga ba'i brgyan pa'i lte ba laḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phrosaḥ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangasaḥ thod pa'i bdud rtsi la thim pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi 'dod dgu thams cad 'byung ba'i rang bzhin du gyuraḥ (657)oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañca amṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ lan gsamaḥ ma hā ba ling ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ lan gsumaḥ ma hā rak+ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ lan gsu+umaḥ rang gi mdun du snang srid thams cad srid pa ma mo'i dkyil 'khor khrag zhag gi dbal klong rab tu 'khrugs pa'i klong bhan+dha 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang ཿ phyogs mtshams skyong ba bcu'i mgo bos phyogs phyogs kyi rtsigs pa byas pa la gnam lcags kyi gzer (658)btab cing lha chen po brgyad kyi ka ba la klu chen po brgyad gdung du bres paḥ gza' chen po brgyad kyi phyam dang ཿ rgyu skar gyi dral zibaḥ ru dra'i thog dang chu srin gyi rta babasaḥ chos 'khor smug nag gdugs phub pa'i g.yas g.yon nas chu srin gyi phru gu blta baḥ

stag dom seng ge la sogs pa gcan gzan gdug pa can gyi mgo bos kha bad byus shing ཿ zhes sdang sbrul gyi chun po la thod pa (659)tshul bur brgyus pa'i dra ba dang dra phyed dpyang paḥ 'dod rnam la mchod pa'i lha mo rnams gar byed cing*/ byang shar nas rim pa'i zur bzhir rdo rje dang ཿ gnam lcags dang ཿ dar zab dang ཿ khrag gi rgyal mtshan chen po bzhi gnas pa'oḥ pho brang chen po de yi phyi rim thod pa lcags kyi grong khyer la gshin rje dang ཿ bdud dang ཿ srin po'i tshogs gnas shing mtha' lcags ri nag pos (660)bskor ba'i nang khongs su dur khrod chen po brgyad la ro rnam pa sna tshogs bam pa dang ཿ rdul ba dang ཿ myags pa dngaḥ stag dang gzigs dang dom dang dred la sogs pa'i gcan gzan dang ཿ dur bya kaṅka dang ཿ bzhan la sogs pa'i sha zan mang pos gang baḥ dur shing dang ཿ rtsubs shing dang ཿ tsher ma can gyi nags 'dabs la gnod sbyin dang ཿ sha za dang ཿ ro langs dang ཿ phra men dang ཿ ma mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs (661)dpag tu med paḥ mdor na dur khrod kyi chos ma tshang ba med pas 'jigs par byas pa'i mtha' me dpung dang rdo rje'i ra bas rgya yongs su ma chad paḥ de yi lto ba la phrin las rnam pa bzhi lhun gyis grub pa'i nagasaḥ thod mkhar gru gsum rgya khyon chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam pa'i dbus su sna tshogs ro'i gdan laḥ dpal sngags kyi bdag mo nag mo khros ma'i rgyal moḥ kun tu bzang mo'i (662)sprul paḥ 'khor 'das thams cad kyi bdag nyid chen mo la nyid las mi gzhan pa'i 'khor dkar mo'i tshogs dang ཿ ser mo'i tshogs dang ཿ dmar mo'i tshogs dang ཿ mthing nag la sogs pa grangs dang mthas mi gtugs paḥ la la mjes pa'i cha byad canaḥ la la khro zhing gtum paḥ la la chags shing bzhad pa la sogasaḥ mdor na ye shes dang las la grub pa'i ma mo'i mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnam 'gyur dang (663)ming gis tha dad du grub pa'i rigs thams cad dang ཿ

'khor lo rgyas 'debs ma'i sku'i sprul pa dam can ma mo bcu gnyisaḥ gsung sprul mkha' 'gro chen mo lngaḥ phrin las kyi sprul pa brtan ma bcu gnyisaḥ g.yas su sbyor ba'i ging chenaḥ dpal ldan ye shes mgon poḥ sprul pa'i mgon po sde lngaḥ dpal mgon bdun cu'i tshogs sprul pa yang 'khor dang bcas paḥ g.yon du (664)sgrol ba'i ging chenaḥ skyes mchog rdo rje legs pa the'u brang stong sde dang bcas paḥ rgyab tu gsang ba'i sgrol ging gza' bdud srog gi spu griḥ gza' brgyad gdong mo bzhi dang bcas paḥ mdun du sbas pa'i dkor srung dur khrod lha mo gtsug lag khang dang dgon gnas rnams kyi dkor cha srung zhing nor la kruḥ rdzas la gnod sbyinaḥ zas la 'dre mor rdzu zhing ngan pa'i ngan ne ma dmar moḥ dar nag gi go zu can (665)g.yas lcags kyu dang ཿ g.yon me long bsnams paḥ ming sring brgyad dang bcas paḥ mdor na srid pa ma mo'i dkyil 'khor du dam tshig dang thugs rjes 'khod pa'i sngags srung dregs pa'i tshogs dang bcas pa rang bzhin gar bzhugs kyi gnas nas spyan drang bar gyuraḥ srog sngags bzla zhing dbyangs rol bcas spyan drangasaḥ hūm̐ḥ khrag mtsho lcags kyi ra ba canaḥ dur khrod rol pa'i gzhal yas khang ཿ thod mkhar gru trag rak+sha mu tra muḥ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ḥ rak+mo te keṃ tsa tsaḥ ru lu ru lu ma hoṃ bh+yoḥ ma hā kā la sha sa na hūm̐ḥ badz+ra pā rdu triḥ (666)gsum ro gdan dbusaḥ khros ma nag mo 'bar ba'i gdong ཿ e ka tsa ṭi ra la gcig maḥ spyan gcig dus gsum kun la gzigasaḥ tshems gcig dgra bo'i srog la rngamasaḥ mthing nag g.yu yi ral pa canaḥ g.yas na dgra snying dron mo 'chang ཿ g.yon pas g.yu spyang khra thabs 'gyedaḥ zhabs gnyis gyad kyi dor stabs canaḥ sku yi sprul pa bal mo 'bumaḥ gsung sprul ma sring (667)mkha' 'gro 'gyedaḥ thugs sprul mon mo nag mo dang ཿ yon tan phrin las bsam mi khyabaḥ

'khor dang bcas pa gshegs su gsolaḥ g.yas su sbyor ba'i ging chen niḥ lha chen dpal 'bar ma ning nagaḥ rab tu khros pa srin po'i gdong ཿ spyan gsum thod skam dbu brgyan canaḥ sbrul nag gson ma'i ral pa 'phyoḥ g.yas g.yon ru mtshon snying zhags 'phyaraḥ sku yi mgon po stag zhon (668)dang ཿ gsung gi mgon po bing dmar poḥ thugs kyi mgon po gri gug canaḥ yon tan mgon po legs ldan nagaḥ phrin las mgon po drag shad dang ཿ lha klu gza' skar phyogs skyong bcuḥ 'jigs byed dgu dang rgyal chen bzhiḥ dpal mgon bdun cu yang 'khor bcasaḥ 'ogi na gnas dang bsil ba tshalaḥ ri rab zom dang go la'i ngosaḥ rang bzhin gnas nas gshegs su gsolaḥ g.yon du sgrol ba'i ging (669)chen niḥ skyes mchog badz+ra thig le rtsalaḥ sku mdog me yi phung po 'draḥ dar dkar ral gu stag sham canaḥ g.yas g.yon rdo rje dgra snying bsnamasaḥ chibs su seng ge dkar mo bcibasaḥ mchod 'khor sum brgya drug cu dang ཿ the'u brang mon pa stong sde'i tshogasaḥ lha srin sde brgyad 'khor dang bcasaḥ srin yul laṅga su ri dang ཿ dbu ru zhwa yi lha khang sogasaḥ dben gnas gnyan po gar bzhugs (670)nasaḥ skad cig yud la gshegs su gsolaḥ drag rak+sha e ka tsa ti ma ma bh+yoḥ ma hā kā la shā sa na jaḥ ri badz+ra pā dhu sa ma ya jaḥ zhes rol mo'i sgra dang gsur chen gyi dud pas spyan drangasaḥ bzhugs gsol niḥ bh+yoḥ lcam mo chen mo bzhugs su gsolaḥ dral po chen po bzhugs su gsolaḥ sbyor sgrol ging chen bzhugs su gsolaḥ 'khor dang bcas pa tiṣ+ṭha lhanaḥ de nas mchod pa 'bul ba niḥ bh+yoḥ ting 'jin sprul pa'i gnas mchog 'diraḥ (671)thugs dam skong ba'i dam rdzas niḥ dngos su bshams dang yid las byung ཿ byang chub sems dang a mṛ taḥ myos byed dba' klong 'khrugs pa dang ཿ srog chags mdangs kyis thugs dam bskang ཿ sna tshogs sha dang snying gi khragaḥ dkar gsum mngar gsum ro drug zasaḥ

nyer spyod ba ling gtor ma dang ཿ spyan gzigs mchod pas thugs dam bskang ཿ sgrub rdzas rba dkar tshig gsum dang ཿ dug khrag sbyar (672)ba gnad kyi rgyuḥ gson khrag rlabs pa phyur ba yisaḥ 'dod chags can gyi thugs dam bskang ཿ shes rab mtshal dang spyi blugs zhwaḥ sha khrag snying sna ru mtshon dang ཿ rma bya'i rgyal mtshan tsit+ta'i togaḥ le rgan dar dang mthing nag guraḥ snel mo'i mgo dang g.yang gzhi snying ཿ nal bu'i sha khrag lug nag gsobaḥ rkang gling thod rnga ltag sprod sogasaḥ rten rdzas rnams kyis thugs dam bskang ཿ bya nag lugs (673)nag khyi nag 'briḥ mi khyi rta yi bam chen dang ཿ mdos dang 'bras bu sna tshogs paḥ bskang rdzas rnams kyis thugs dam bskang ཿ rta dang g.yag nag gri snying gisaḥ dpal ldan mgon po'i thugs dam bskang ཿ ra yi sha khrag gsur chen gyisaḥ skyes bu chen pa'i thugs dam bskang ཿ sha khrag snying sna ra mchin gyisaḥ gza' bdud 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang ཿ dkar mngar 'o chol (674)rta bong shasaḥ dur khrod bdag mo'i thugs dam bskang ཿ mdor na snang srid snod bcud kunaḥ dbang po drug gi spyod yul duḥ rang rang mthun pa'i dam rdzas kyisaḥ sprul 'khor yongs rdzogs thugs dam bskang ཿ khyad par dus kyi tha ma laḥ srid pa'i bde sdug ma mos byedaḥ 'byung ba lnga yang yum lnga'i klong ཿ de phyir srid pa ma mor gragasaḥ dbyings la rnam rtog mi mnga' yang ཿ rtsal las sprul pa shar ba'i tsheḥ legs (675)nyes stangs 'jin ma mo niḥ ko long ru nga gdug rtsub cheḥ rnal 'byor thabs la mi mkhas shing ཿ 'jig rten rmongs pa'i dbang gyur pasaḥ lha mo'i dam tshig gang dang gang ཿ de kun dang du ma blangs shing ཿ dkar dmar thab dang gzhob la sogasaḥ thugs dang 'gal ba'i las bgyis paḥ khyod la mthong lalo bzod par bzhesaḥ dbyings dang 'gal ba'i las bgyis paḥ khyod la mthol lo bzod par bzhesaḥ dbyings nas bka' chad ma btang cigaḥ shwa dang rde'u ma 'grems shigaḥ

(676)khram dang dal kha ma ston cigaḥ mtshon dru nad rkyal ma brdeg cigaḥ god kha gnas 'gyur ma btang cigaḥ thugs dam gnyan po bskangs gyur nasaḥ zhi rgyas gnyis kyis gso ba dang ཿ dbang drag rol pa'i mngon spyod kyisaḥ las bzhi'i dngos grub bdag la stsolaḥ do gal chen phud skong bya steḥ phud nyung du tsam la byar mi rung ngau ཿ hoḥ 'og min bde ba chen po'i zhing naḥ kun tu bzang mo dbyings kyi yum chenaḥ nyi shu rtsa bzhi sprul (677)pa'i yul naḥ ma mo mkha' 'gro kun gyi rje moḥ dpal sngags kyi bdag mo nag mo khros ma la gsol loḥ e ka tsa ṭi spun drug la gsol loḥ de'i bran mo bcu bzhi la gsol loḥ g.yog mo lnga bcu rtsa brgyad la gsol loḥ yang g.yog 'bum khri 'bum stong la gsol loḥ nam gru re ma ti la gsol loḥ 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma la gsol loḥ shwa na ma bzhi (678)la gsol loḥ sa bdag ma bzhi la gsol loḥ bdag nyid ma bzhi la gsol loḥ dur khrod bdag mo lcam dral la gsol loḥ dbang gi lha mo tsan+d+ra ka la gsol loḥ shan pa nag mo srog sgrug ma la gsol loḥ lha mo dud sol ma la gsol loḥ rdo rje drag mo rgyal la gsol loḥ ma sring brtan ma bcu gnyis la sogs sprul pa yang sprul nyid sprul rnams la gsol loḥ 'bul loḥ mchod doḥ gsang (679)sngags kyi bstan pa srungs shigaḥ rnal 'byor pa'i mgon skyas mjod cigaḥ bstan 'jin gyi skyes bu spel cigaḥ dgra byung na snying thon cigaḥ bgegs byung na mgo bo khos shigaḥ dug byung na bya thong zhigaḥ byad byung na rang gshed du phob cigaḥ rkyen ngan dang bar chad solaḥ bsam don gyi re ba gang yin pa skad cig nyid la grub par mjod cigaḥ hoḥ rtog pa'i bdag bsgral kun tu bzang poḥ (680)dug gsum ru tra'i gshed du khros pa lha chen dpal 'bar ma ning nag po la gsol loḥ stag zhon sku'i mgon po la gsol loḥ bing dmar gsung gi mgon po la gsol loḥ

gri gug thugs kyi mgon pa la gsol loḥ legs ldan yon tan gyi mgon po la gsol loḥ drag shad phrin las kyi mgon po la gsol loḥ 'bul loḥ mchod doḥ gsang sngags kyi bstan pa srungs shigaḥ rnal 'byor pa'i (681)mgon skyabs mjod cigaḥ bstan 'jin gyi skyes bu spel cigaḥ dgra byung na snying thon cigaḥ bgegs byung na mgo bo khos shigaḥ dug byung na bya thod zhigaḥ byad byung na rang gshed du phob cigaḥ rkyen ngan dang bar chad solaḥ bsam don gyi re ba gang yin pa skad cig nyid la grub par mjod cigaḥ hoḥ gtsang ris lha yi mgon po dbang po dang tshangs pa la gsol loḥ dbang phyug dang khyab 'jug la (682)gsol loḥ gdong drug dang 'dod dbang la gsol loḥ tshogs bdag dang bh+riṃ gi la gsol loḥ klu'i mgon po mtha' yas dang 'jog po la gsol loḥ dung skyong dang stobs rgyu la gsol loḥ pad+ma dang pad+ma chen po la gsol loḥ rigs ldan dang nor rgyas la gsol loḥ drang srong mgon po nyi ma dang zla ba la gsol loḥ mig dmar dang lhag pa la gsol loḥ phur bu dang spa sangs la gsol loḥ spen pa dang sgra (683)gcan la gsol loḥ khyad par du yang khyab 'jug chen poḥ bi nu rā tsaḥ rā hu laḥ bi ṭi pa traḥ ljang sngon drag poḥ du ba mjug ring ཿ bdud po rog tiḥ bi na ya ka la sogs te thog ser dang ltas ngan gyi bdag po sprul pa'i gza' brgyad gdong mo bzhi dang bcas pa la gsol loḥ 'bul loḥ mchod doḥ gsang sngags kyi bstan pa srungs shigaḥ rnal 'byor pa'i mgon skyabs mjod cigaḥ bstan 'jin gyi (684)skyes bu spel cigaḥ dgra byung na snying thon cigaḥ bgegs byung na mgo bo khos shigaḥ dug byung na bya thong zhigaḥ byad byung na rang gshed du phob cigaḥ rkyen ngan dang bar chad solaḥ bsam don gyi re ba gang yin pa skad cig nyid la grub par mjod cigaḥ hoḥ rgyu skar gyi mgon po smin drug dang snar ma la gsol loḥ mgo dang lag pa la gsol loḥ

nabs so dang rgyal la gsol loḥ skag dang rta pa la gsol loḥ (685)bre dang dbo la gsol loḥ me bzhi dang nag pa la gsol loḥ sa ri dang sa ga la gsol loḥ lha mtshams dang snron la gsol loḥ snubs dang chu stod la gsol loḥ chu smad dang gro bzhin la gsol loḥ byi bzhin mon gre la gsol loḥ mon gru dang khrums stod la gsol loḥ khrums smad dang nam gru la gsol loḥ tha skar dang bra nye la gsol loḥ 'bul loḥ mchod doḥ gsang (686)sngags kyi bstan pa srungs shigaḥ rnal 'byor pa'i mgon skyabs mjaud cigaḥ bstan 'jin gyi skyes bu spel cigaḥ dgra byung na snying thon cigaḥ bgegs byung na mgonapo khos shigaḥ dug byung na bya thong zhigaḥ byad byung na rang gshed du phob cigaḥ rkyen ngan dang bar chad solaḥ bsam don gyi re ba gang yin pa skad cig nyid la grub par mjod cigaḥ hoḥ phyogs mtshams skyong ba'i mgon po dbang po dang me lha la gsol loḥ gshin (687)rje dang srin po la gsol loḥ chu lha dang rlung lha la gsol loḥ gnod sbyinadang dbang ldan la gsol loḥ tshangs pa dang gza' skar la gsol loḥ sa yi lha mo dang sa 'jin lag pa chen po la gsol laḥ khyad par du yang 'jig rten skyong ba'i mgon po chen po yul 'khor srung la gsol loḥ 'phags skyes po la gsol loḥ mig mi bzang la gsol loḥ rnam thos sras la gsol loḥ gzhan yang (688)'jigs byed chen po dgu la sogs te dam tshig shes pa dang dkar phyogs skyong ba'i tshogs thams cad la gsol loḥ 'bul loḥ mchod doḥ gsang sngags kyi bstan pa srungs shigaḥ rnal 'byor pa'i mgon skyabs mjod cigaḥ bstan 'jin gyi skyes bu spel cigaḥ dgra byung na snying thon cigaḥ bgegs byung na mgo bo khos shigaḥ dug byung na bya thong zhing ཿ byad byung na rang gshed du phob cigaḥ rkyen ngan dang bar chad solaḥ bsam (689)don gyi re ba gang yin pa skad cig nyid la grub par mjod cigaḥ hoḥ

rdo rje 'jin pa'i bka' nyan chen po sgrol ging rdo rje legs pa la gsol loḥ rnal 'byor yongs kyi srung ma chen po la gsol loḥ dpa' bo yongs kyi dgra lha chen po la gsol loḥ tshong pa yongs kyi ded dpon chen po la gsol loḥ brten na snying nye ba la gsol loḥ rbad na mthu che ba la gsol loḥ bskul na las myur (690)ba la gsol loḥ sprul 'khor dang bka' nyan phud dang gtor ma la gdung ba thams cad la gsol loḥ 'bul loḥ mchod doḥ gsang sngags kyi bstan pa srungs shigaḥ rnal 'byor pa'i mgon skyabs mjod cigaḥ bstan 'jin gyi skyes bu spel cigaḥ dgra byung na snying thon cigaḥ bgegs byung na mgo bo khos shigaḥ dug byung na bya thong zhigaḥ byad byung na rang gshed du phob cigaḥ rkyen ngan dang bar chad solaḥ bsam (691)don gyi re ba gang yin pa skad cig nyid la grub par mjod cigaḥ de ltar srid pa ma mo'i dkyil 'khor du ye shes dang las la grub pa'i srung ma thugs dam canaḥ gtsang ris kyi mgon po bdun cu rtsa lnga dang bcas pa khyed rnams zhal mthong ཿ bstan pa dang dam tshig la gusaḥ mthu dang rdzu 'phrul gyi bdag po srid zhi'i khams na che btsan 'gran zla dang bral baḥ mnga' 'og dang sde ris su ma'adus pa gang (692)yang med pasaḥ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungasaḥ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstodaḥ rnal 'byor pa bdag cag la sdang ba'i sems dang ldan paḥ gdug pa'i sems dang ldan paḥ drag shul gyi sems dang ldan paḥ sbyor ba rtsub mo la mos pa'i 'byung po mi dang mi ma yin pa de dag thams cad zhi ba'i phrin las kyis dul bar mjod cigaḥ rgyas pa'i phrin las kyis spa bkongs shigaḥ dbang gi phrin las kyis (693)snang ba sgyur cigaḥ drag po'i phrin las kyis tshar chod cigaḥ bdag dang 'jig rten thams cad la legs pa'i yon tan gong nas gong du 'phel ba'i phrin las mjod cigaḥ

ces phud gtor rol mo sgrogs glu gar gyi mchod pas kyang mnyes par bya'o/ de nas bstod pa ni/ bh+yoḥ dpal ldan rang byung rgyal mo niḥ ma mo yongs kyi sprul gzhi yinaḥ lha yi yul na mdangs ldan maḥ me tog man+da ra la bstodaḥ khrag 'thung dbang (694)thob dpal ldan zungasaḥ gshin rje'i yul na ral gcig maḥ me bza' brag gyon klu yi mtshanaḥ nag mo khrag 'jag ma la bstodaḥ ma ni snying po byang chub semasaḥ mo ni rang byung ye shes phyiraḥ gang nas bos kyang khyod kyi mtshanaḥ 'dod khams bdag mo khyod la bstodaḥ bdag lta'i ru tra bsgral ba lasaḥ byang chub sems kyi mgon po byung ཿ theg dgu rdzogs pa'i dar nag giḥ 'jol bar dgu (695)brtsegs mnabs la bstodaḥ gzung 'jin ru tra zhabs kyis brdzis snying phreng mi mgo'i do shal 'phyang ཿ bing chen sked btsugs dmag gsum 'gyedaḥ bdud dang srin po 'dul la bstodaḥ ging chen rdo rje legs pa skyong ཿ 'jam bu gling gi mnga' bdag poḥ rnam 'gyur sprul pa cir yang stonaḥ rdzu 'phrul bdag po khyod la bstodaḥ res 'ga' mgar nag khros pa'i gdong ཿ than dang ltas ngan yongs kyi (696)bdagaḥ res 'ga' gnod sbyin nor lha'i tshulaḥ dngos grub bdag po khyod la bstodaḥ khyad par gtsug lag khang srung zhing ཿ dam nyams srog la hur thum dang ཿ gri rgod 'bebs pa'i drag shul canaḥ gsang ba'i sgrol ging gnyis la bstodaḥ mdor na ma mgon lcam dral gyiḥ bka' dang 'khor na gnas pa yiḥ legs nyes stangs 'jin 'jig rten gyiḥ bdag po kun la rab tu bstodaḥ phrin las bcol ba niḥ bh+yoḥ sum cu rtsa (697)gsum lha yul naḥ skye rgyud bdag po yab yum gnyisaḥ ma mjal yid kyi sbyor ba lasaḥ dpral bar lcags kyi rmen pa sharaḥ yum gyi dmod pastobs btsan pasaḥ nag mo khros ma ral gcig maḥ bcu bdun rgyud kyi bka' srung duḥ gsang ba'i bdag pos dbang yang bskuraḥ bdag med kun tu bzang mo'i klong ཿ

bdag lta'i ru tra sangs rgyas pa'iḥ dpal ldan ma mgon lcam dral laḥ dam (698)tshig phran las gnyer du gtodaḥ sangs rgyas bstan pa khyod kyis srungasaḥ dkon mchog dbu 'phang khyod kyis bstodaḥ bstan 'jin skyes bu'i sku tshe bsringasaḥ snying tig gnyan po'i bya ra mjodaḥ 'jig rten khams su nad mtshon dang ཿ mu ge'i bskal pa ngan pa chodaḥ 'gong po spun dgu sde ris kyiḥ dpung dang rgya 'dre'i lam srangs srungasaḥ rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyiḥ nad gdon bar gcod kun sol laḥ tshe dpal (699)longs spyod dbang thang kunaḥ yar ngo'i zla ba lta bur mjodaḥ dkor khang 'di ru rtag bzhugs laḥ sku gsung thugs kyi rten rnams dang ཿ dkor cha longs spyod bcas pa laḥ bla rdo chos la mel tshe gyisaḥ sgrub pa mchog la gus pa dang ཿ dam pa chos kyi brgyud 'jin cing ཿ sems can yongs la phan brtson pa'iḥ slob ma'i 'du ba rgyas par mjodaḥ dus gsum kun na gdug pa dang ཿ sdang ba'i (700)sems ldan dgra dang bgegasaḥ gang yin khyed kyi zas skal duḥ gtad de mngon spyod phrin las mjodaḥ chos srid bstan pa'i phrin las rnamasaḥ sde bzhi'i dpal gyis mngon mthong zhing ཿ glo bur las bcol ba ling kunaḥ bzhes la bsam don lhun grub mjodaḥ ces brjod phud gtor gtsang par gshegasaḥ 'di ni nang gi bka' srung steḥ sngon chad rgyud du gnas pa lasaḥ gab pa mngon du phyung ba medaḥ gnad yig gcig dang bka' srung rgyudaḥ ma bu zung du 'brel ba naḥ srid pa (701)(702) dkrugs pa pad+mas shesaḥ de phyir lcags sde so sor rgyaḥ snying thig 'dra min spyod pa'i tsheḥ rang byung sprul pa'i rdo rje dang ཿ 'phrad nas bstan pa bsrung bar shogaḥ sa ma yāḥ brda thimaḥ dge'o/// /
